gaps.reason: ownerEmployeeId requires an authoritative directory search API with pagination, data-scope enforcement, and a minimal active-employee projection. No such contract exists. The create entry is visibly blocked, submit emission is disabled, the service is not called, and no empty UUID, typed UUID, static option, or cached local truth is sent.

substituteEmployeeId requires the same authoritative scoped directory contract plus active-duty eligibility. REQUEST_CHANGE remains visibly blocked, emits no action, never calls the service, and never sends an empty or fabricated identifier.
